scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const copy=(src,dst)=>{fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); for(const file of fs.readdirSync(src)){const srcPath=path.join(src,file); const dstPath=path.join(dst,file); if(fs.statSync(srcPath).isFile()){fs.copyFileSync(srcPath,dstPath);}}}; copy('src/assets/images','dist/src/assets/images'); copy('src/assets/images','dist/assets/images');" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('assets',{recursive:true}); for(const f of ['app.js','app.css']){const s=path.join('dist','assets',f); if(fs.existsSync(s)) fs.copyFileSync(s,path.join('assets',f));}" && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
